summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it on `math_init.js` shipped alongside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with heavy string-array/index obfuscation (shifted numeric constant tables, `WV8StW`-style array rotation, hex-mangled identifiers) that is not listed in `package.json` `files` (which only declares `dist`). The payload is not resolvable via Node and executes only under the freshly-downloaded Bun binary, evading tooling that inspects Node-reachable code. The published library body (`dist/test-utils.js`, 905 bytes) copies the legitimate `@nebula.js/test-utils` v0.6.0 header verbatim from QlikTech, while this version 0.6.1 grafts on the preinstall dropper and bundled payload — consistent with a scope hijack or account takeover of the Qlik `@nebula.js` scope. Installing this package auto-runs the obfuscated bundle against every installer under an alien runtime the package itself provisions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
